title: IN WHICH PASSEPARTOUT TAKES A TOO GREAT INTEREST IN HIS MASTER, AND WHAT COMES OF IT
summary_hover: In Hong Kong, Fix reveals his true identity to Passepartout and, upon being rebuffed, drugs him with opium to stall Fogg.
summary_detail: While exploring Hong Kong, Passepartout discovers that the steamer 'Carnatic' is departing for America that very evening instead of the next morning. He meets Fix, who invites him to a tavern and reveals he is a London detective pursuing Phileas Fogg for a bank robbery. When Passepartout fiercely refuses to betray his master, Fix drugs him with an opium pipe to ensure Fogg misses the early departure of the steamer.
